title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Asha Raman
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated regions require deterministic KMS residency for encryption keys and a clear, tamper-evident audit trail when RBAC v2 policy decisions cause data to be routed or encrypted in a pinned region. This PR implements enforcement of KMS region pinning in the RBAC v2 policy evaluator, adds structured audit events for KMS pin enforcement, and tightens logging to include policy decision context for compliance investigations. Implementation summary: 1) rbac_v2 policy enforcer now consults the kms residency resolver when a resource has a kms_region constraint; policy evaluation will deny requests if the requested region conflicts unless an explicit override grant exists; 2) kms client adds a region_pin helper and validation hooks with unit/integration tests; 3) audit-logging pipeline extended to emit structured fields (policy_id, decision_reason, kms_region_requested, kms_region_effective, grant_id) and a background indexer to ensure logs are available for retention queries; 4) feature flag rollout rbac_v2.kms_region_enforce with staged canary to 10% then 100%; 5) migration: audit backfill utility included to mark recent events with the new schema. Checklist: [x] add policy enforcer checks; [x] add kms region pin resolver and validation; [x] structured audit events and indexer; [x] comprehensive unit tests; [x] integration tests against local KMS emulator and policy fixtures; [x] add feature flag and rollout plan; [x] update docs and release notes at https://redwood.example/docs/security/rbac-v2-kms. Related: Linear ENG-4123, SEC-789, PM-102.
